verdict.rationale: Stagehand documents a local browser mode (`localBrowser.launch`) as an alternative to Browserbase, and an option to attach over CDP (`localBrowser.connect`) to any Chromium browser already running on your machine. Local user-data directories persist cookies and storage across runs. missing for 10: an explicit statement that no Browserbase/cloud account is needed in local mode (server-side caching hints at a cloud dependency for some features), and independent or hands-on corroboration of local-only development.
